description: Selection of available days and times, with summary and time zone.

howToUse: Use it to book a time: a visit, an appointment, a call. The person picks a day, then one of the times available that day.
Pass the free times your server computed, and mark the busy ones with `unavailable`. Limit the days with `minDate` and `maxDate`.
Set `timezone` whenever the person and the place can be in different time zones; the summary shows it.
Confirm the booking on your server before saying it is done: the time can be taken in the meantime.
alternatives: Only a date, with no time: DatePicker or Calendar.

keyboard.action: Moves from the calendar to the times and then to the summary.
Moves one day or one week, as in Calendar.
Selects the day or the time in focus.
